sections.Profile:
"Capt. Card" is a 1974 pinball machine by Gottlieb, designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison. It features a card game theme with four banks of drop targets representing the suits in a deck of cards, emphasizing target shooting accuracy.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1973–1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wedgehead, Card games, Original Theme, 1970s, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Gordon Morison
- Design: Ed Krynski
